  *****NOTE FROM THE CITY*****

Doors to the City Council Chamber will open at 1:30 p.m. for Open Session. Please be mindful that
seating is limited and available on a first come, first served basis.

ALTERNATIVE METHODS
The City provides the following two alternative methods of viewing and listening to the City Council Meeting
convenience:

  ¡  On Spectrum Cable Channel 35 with audio and limited video. Please check with your cable provider
  for details.
  ¡  Live online through Facebook Live, with audio and limited video,
  at https://www.facebook.com/cityofinglewood/

The disruption in service of any alternative method does not preclude the City Council or other legislative body
from taking further action on an agenda item.

Submitting Comments Prior to Public Meeting: Members of the public may choose to submit comments
electronically for consideration by the City Council or other City Legislative Body by sending them to the City
Clerk/Secretary at athompson@cityofinglewood.org, and Deputy City Clerk at aallen@cityofinglewood.org. To
ensure distribution to the members of the Legislative Body prior to consideration of the agenda, please submit
comments prior to 8:00 a.m. the day of the meeting, and in the body of the email, please identify the agenda
number or subject matter. Correspondence should indicate the meeting date and agenda item. Comments receiv
after 8:00 a.m. and prior to the close of the public hearings will be made part of the official public record of the
meeting. Contact the Office of the City Clerk at 310-412-5280 with any questions.

to athompson@cityofinglewood.org and aallen@cityofinglewood.org no later than 24 hours prior to the scheduled

 These items will be acted upon as a whole unless called upon by a Council Member.

  1.  Samuel Tapia for alleged property damage; loose metal plate in road on December 28, 2023.

  B.  Return Late Claim in accordance with Government Code, Section 911.2:

  contractor on February 16, 2022.

  Recommendation:

  Staff report recommending that the Mayor and Council Members award a contract and approve the
  attached two (2)-year agreement (with the option to extend for two (2) additional terms of one (1) year

   Documents:

  and the City of Inglewood, which serves as the Administrative Entity for the South Bay Workforce
  Investment Board (SBWIB).

  Recommendation:

  4.PDF

 5. FINANCE DEPARTMENT

  D. Ivery dba Political Reporting Plus to continue to occupy 700 square feet of office space on the
  seventh floor of Inglewood City Hall (Suite 700).

  Recommendation:
  1. Approve lease agreement.

  Documents:

  5.PDF

 6. PARKS, RECREATION AND COMMUNITY SERVICES DEPARTMENT

  Staff report recommending that the Mayor and Council Members authorize payment of an invoice
  submitted by Ramirez Productions & Event Rentals, Inc., for equipment rentals for the City’s “Light Up
  Market Street” Holiday Fair and Tree Lighting Ceremony. (General Fund)

  Recommendation:
  1. Authorize payment in the amount of $6,171.02.

  Documents:

  6.PDF

 7. POLICE DEPARTMENT

  Staff report recommending that the Mayor and Council Members approve the attached one
  (1)-year agreement (with the option to extend three (3) additional one (1)-year terms) with
  Shield Telehealth & Medical Services, LLC (Shield TMS) to provide non-emergency
  medical treatment for in-custody prisoners. (General Fund and Grant Fund)
  Recommendation:
  1. Approve agreement in the total amount of $188,250 (includes a contingency in the
  amount of $20,000); and
  2. Authorize payment of invoices in the total amount of $50,765. (General Fund)

  Documents:

  7.PDF
